recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1980s hip-hop group portrait featuring three women in athletic-inspired streetwear, characterized by high-contrast neon accents, heavy gold jewelry, and a layered typographic header set against a textured, pastel-gradient studio backdrop.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject trio arranged in a tight, overlapping diagonal composition from bottom-left to top-right.
Interaction between bold neon pink clothing and the matching pink neon-tube style lettering.
Contrast between the crisp, geometric sportswear patterns and the soft, grainy texture of the background.
coreInvariants: Grainy, film-like texture across the entire image.
Prominent use of oversized sunglasses on all subjects.
Layered rectangular blocks in the top-left corner containing the primary text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the center and right two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top-left corner contains a dense stack of three text blocks that anchor the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the high-contrast text block in the top-left, moves down the central figure's white sweatshirt, and follows the diagonal line of the three heads toward the top-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily concentrated in the top-left and bottom-right corners with a light purple/pink wash.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and light blue provide the base for the central figure's clothing and the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neon pink acts as a structural element in the clothing and the primary logo.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and gold appear in the jewelry, sweatshirt graphics, and secondary text bar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the neon elements against a desaturated, high-value pastel background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy sans-serif and rounded display faces.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a double-inline 'neon tube' effect with rounded terminals.
Secondary title uses a heavy, italicized geometric sans-serif.
Text is contained within high-contrast rectangular blocks tilted at a slight angle.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' and 'F' characters feature exaggerated rounded curves to mimic bent neon glass.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking contrasting color blocks with varied weights of sans-serif type.

preserve: The neon-tube effect on the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, heavy geometry of the primary title.
Matches the aggressive, slanted weight of the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of three women in 1980s hip-hop fashion (oversized sweatshirts with grid patterns, neon pink crop tops, gold chains, large sunglasses). The background is a soft, grainy lavender and light blue gradient. The lighting is flat and bright, typical of 80s commercial photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three stacked, slightly tilted rectangular blocks in the top-left corner: a black block with neon pink rounded inline text, a yellow block with heavy black italicized sans-serif text, and a smaller black block with thin yellow sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Text blocks are tilted at a consistent negative angle.
Image has a visible film grain or halftone texture.
Color palette includes neon pink and bright yellow.

adjustableVariables: Angle of the text block tilt
Specific patterns on the clothing (e.g., grid vs. stripes)
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the clothing
The exact facial features of the original subjects
The specific wording of the original artist and album names
postGenerationChecks: Does the image feel like a physical 1980s CD or vinyl cover?
Are the neon colors sufficiently vibrant against the pastel background?
Is the typography integrated into the composition via the angled blocks?
Is the grain texture consistent across both subjects and background?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [80s hip-hop fashion trio] + [grainy pastel studio backdrop] + [stacked angled color-block typography] + [neon pink and yellow accents].
